Privacy policy

Updated 20 November 2026

Mob uses the information below to run your workspace. You can use tasks and the focus timer as a guest, or sign in to sync supported features.

Information Mob uses

  • Workspace. Guest tasks, timer activity and preferences stay in browser or app storage. Signed-in tasks and supported settings sync through Supabase. Web and Windows can also sync completed focus sessions and timer state. Android keeps individual focus sessions on the device.
  • Account. Supabase Auth processes your email, sign-in details and session. If you sign in with Google, Mob receives the profile information supplied by Google, including a display name and photo when available.
  • Flow. If you enable tracking, the Windows app measures foreground app time and the extension measures time by active website domain. Mob syncs totals such as time, visits, device and time bucket for your dashboard and limits. Flow reports cover up to 30 calendar days. The extension does not send page text, keystrokes or full browsing URLs to Mob. Android does not collect app usage. Its optional Shorts blocker uses Accessibility to recognize and dismiss the Shorts player in YouTube.
  • Social. Sharing a score is optional. If enabled, signed-in users can see your username, focus minutes, ranking and supported Google profile photo. Android shares a focus total, rather than individual session entries.

External services

Supabase provides sign-in and account storage. Google handles Google sign-in and hosts Google profile photos. Spotify loads when you open its player and handles playback under its own privacy policy. Netlify and Vercel host the web pages and can receive request data such as your IP address. GitHub hosts Mob’s installers. Your browser stores session and preference data on your device.

Your choices and deletion

Turn off Flow tracking in Flow and turn off score sharing in Social. Clear tracked usage from Flow. Delete your account from the account menu to remove the account and associated records from Mob’s active database. Sign out and clear browser or app storage to remove local data from a particular device. Backups and provider logs may follow their providers’ retention schedules.

Contact

Mob is maintained by Lakshya. Use the Mob issue tracker to ask for a private way to contact the maintainer about access, corrections, deletion or a privacy concern. The tracker is public, so keep personal information and account details out of it.

Custom profile photos are stored in Mob’s database so they can appear on your signed-in devices. You can remove your photo in Profile.
